notes: Verified live 2026-10-07 in headless Chrome. Intelius removes public records through the PeopleConnect suppression center: the privacy center's "Manage My Suppression Rules" link opens https://suppression.peopleconnect.us/?brand=Intelius in a new tab, so the recipe goes there directly. That page asks for an email address and a consent box and then emails a verification link, which the confirm task follows. The user-data tools on the privacy center (copy of data, delete user data) are a different right and are not used. Nothing was submitted.
